correction: The umask fix of PR #525 covered the lock, rollback and last-run directories, but 7 other os.MkdirAll calls for directories that updex creates as root still applied the umask: the staging directory, the sysext link directory, the catalog component directory, the feature drop-in directory and the parents the two rollback snapshots recreate. Under umask 0077 or 0027 they came out 0700 or 0750, so the config loader (collectConfigFiles, applyFeatureDropIns) and the staging-directory read returned permission denied to every non-root reader. Each of them now calls dirmode.MkdirAll (0755), the helper that PR #525 added, moved to internal/dirmode so download and sysext can use it too. One test per site runs under umask 0o022 and 0o077 and asserts the created directory is exactly 0755.
evidence: follow-up of frostyard/updex#525: 7 os.MkdirAll sites for root-created directories that non-root readers list
